description: eos::ResidualTerm::NonAnalytic::accumulate is currently a no-op; data is carried. Implement the IAPWS-95/Span-Wagner non-analytic term alpha + first/second delta,tau derivatives with the delta=1 (critical density) limit guard. Needed for accuracy within ~1% of the critical point (Water, CO2). Verify at Water critical/reducing state (p=22.064 MPa, delta=tau=1) and near-critical points.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
Scaffolded 2026-07-10 (src/eos.rs): the ResidualTerm::NonAnalytic match arm now calls a documented private accumulate_non_analytic(...) helper (still a no-op — Water/CO2 carry NonAnalytic and must not panic). Helper doc states the theta/Delta/psi term structure + the delta=1 limit guard to implement (IAPWS R6-95 Table 6.5 / CoolProp ResidualHelmholtzNonAnalytic).
IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-10: accumulate_non_analytic() in eos.rs fully ported from CoolProp Helmholtz.cpp (theta/DELTA/PSI + first/second derivatives, delta=1/tau=1 branch-point offset guard). Verified: Water p(Tc,rho_c)=p_c to 5.2e-14 rel err (tests/non_analytic_critical_region.rs). Bead can be closed.

title: Implement non-analytic critical-region residual terms (+ delta=1 handling)

description: Goal: all workspace crates' non-GUI library code builds for Android (aarch64-linux-android + armv7/x86_64 emulator). Mechanism: Android-hostile deps (ndarray-linalg / system BLAS-LAPACK, C/Fortran toolchains, GUI/windowing) are target-gated OFF Android, and any test/bench/example using them is cfg(not(target_os=android))-gated so it does not compile there. Standing rule now in the workspace CLAUDE.md ('Android portability'). GUI (egui/eframe) items are out of scope for Android.
title: Android support: every crate's non-GUI code compiles/runs on Android
